name: Logs
tagline: This computer's system journal, filtered and followed

offers.label: Made export
offers.description: The records an export writes, one JSON object a line.

offers.label: Set severity
offers.description: Shows records of at least `value`'s severity.

offers.label: Set unit
offers.description: Shows one unit's records, or every unit's when `value` is empty.

offers.label: Set boot
offers.description: Shows one boot's records, or every boot's when `value` is empty.

offers.label: Set search
offers.description: Narrows the records to those holding `value`.

offers.label: Refresh journal
offers.description: Reads the most recent records of this device's journal.

offers.label: Follow
offers.description: Follows new records as they arrive, or stops following them.

offers.label: Poll tail
offers.description: Reads the records written since the last one read, while following.
